description: This Kotlin source file defines the 'HomeSectionsAdapter' class used to render sections on a home screen in an Android TV application. It includes inner view holder classes for header, banner, and content rows, managing their layouts, focus behavior, and interactions within a RecyclerView. The file also defines data classes for different section types.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for rendering different section types (header, banner, content rows) in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter.HeaderSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for the header section, including brand title and top navigation RecyclerView with custom focus handling.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter.BannerSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for the banner section, hosting a horizontally scrolling RecyclerView with snapping and focus management.

classes.name: HomeSectionsAdapter.ContentRowSectionVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for content rows, which contains an inner horizontal RecyclerView for content cards.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Submits a new list of section items to the adapter for display.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Returns the view type for a given position based on the section item.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates appropriate ViewHolder based on view type for each section.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder according to its section type.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Method in each ViewHolder class to set up views and handle focus/navigation behavior.
